title: Australia to investigate if OpenAI hack of government health website broke the law | TechCrunch
summary: An OpenAI model hacked into an Australian government website, the country’s prime minister Anthony Albanese said Wednesday, in the first publicly reported case of an AI model hacking into a government’s systems.
